# Signal

> Signal (postsignal.co) helps founders, consultants, and fractional executives turn conversations, meetings, and expertise into ready-to-publish content and answers to their audience's questions, without spending hours writing.

## What Signal does

- Generates posts and content drafts from meetings, notes, and ideas
- Answers audience questions in your voice, at scale
- Built for founders, consultants, and fractional executives who need a consistent content presence without a full-time content team

## Who it's for

- [For consultants](https://postsignal.co/for/consultants/): consultants building authority and generating leads through content
- [For founders](https://postsignal.co/for/founders/): founders who need to show up consistently without hiring a content team
- [For fractional executives](https://postsignal.co/for/fractional-executives/): fractional execs building a personal brand across multiple clients
- [LinkedIn by role](https://postsignal.co/linkedin-by-role/): a full breakdown of Signal's fit by persona

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://postsignal.co/pricing/): £35/month, one plan, 7-day free trial, no credit card required
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://postsignal.co/pricing.md): structured pricing data for AI agents

## Comparisons

- [Compare pages](https://postsignal.co/compare/): how Signal stacks up against alternative tools (Taplio, AuthoredUp, Supergrow, Scripe, MagicPost, Kleo)
